# A route path method returns the path as a string, as it always did, so
# {{.Path.GetItem 7}} renders /item/7. The Route field of the paths has the same
# methods and returns a TemplateRoute, which prints as the path and names the
# HTTP method of the route.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test

-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET /item/{id} GetItem(id)"}}<a href="{{.Path.GetItem 7}}">item</a>{{end}}

{{define "POST /item/{id} PostItem(id)"}}{{.Path.PostItem 7}}{{end}}

{{define "GET /{$} Index()"}}<a href="{{.Path.Index}}">home</a>{{end}}

{{define "GET /route/{id} GetRoute(id)"}}<a href="{{.Path.Route.GetItem 7}}">{{.Path.Route.GetItem 7}}</a>{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetItem(id int) int  { return id }
func (Server) PostItem(id int) int { return id }
func (Server) Index() string       { return "" }
func (Server) GetRoute(id int) int { return id }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func serve(t *testing.T, mux *http.ServeMux, method, target string) string {
	t.Helper()
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(method, target, nil))
	body, err := io.ReadAll(rec.Result().Body)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return string(body)
}

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	paths := TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	if got := serve(t, mux, http.MethodGet, "/item/3"); !strings.Contains(got, `<a href="/item/7">item</a>`) {
		t.Errorf("GET /item/3 = %q, want a link to /item/7", got)
	}
	if got := serve(t, mux, http.MethodPost, "/item/3"); !strings.Contains(got, "/item/7") {
		t.Errorf("POST /item/3 = %q, want /item/7", got)
	}
	if got := serve(t, mux, http.MethodGet, "/"); !strings.Contains(got, `<a href="/">home</a>`) {
		t.Errorf("GET / = %q, want a link to /", got)
	}

	if got := serve(t, mux, http.MethodGet, "/route/3"); !strings.Contains(got, `<a href="/item/7">/item/7</a>`) {
		t.Errorf("GET /route/3 = %q, want a link to /item/7", got)
	}

	for _, tt := range []struct{ got, want string }{
		{paths.GetItem(7), "/item/7"},
		{paths.PostItem(7), "/item/7"},
		{paths.Index(), "/"},
	} {
		if tt.got != tt.want {
			t.Errorf("path = %q, want %q", tt.got, tt.want)
		}
	}

	getItem, postItem, index := paths.Route.GetItem(7), paths.Route.PostItem(7), paths.Route.Index()
	for _, tt := range []struct {
		name                 string
		route                TemplateRoute
		wantMethod, wantPath string
	}{
		{"GET with a parameter", getItem, http.MethodGet, "/item/7"},
		{"POST with a parameter", postItem, http.MethodPost, "/item/7"},
		{"index", index, http.MethodGet, "/"},
	} {
		if got := tt.route.Method(); got != tt.wantMethod {
			t.Errorf("%s: Method() = %q, want %q", tt.name, got, tt.wantMethod)
		}
		if got := tt.route.String(); got != tt.wantPath {
			t.Errorf("%s: String() = %q, want %q", tt.name, got, tt.wantPath)
		}
		if got := fmt.Sprint(tt.route); got != tt.wantPath {
			t.Errorf("%s: fmt.Sprint() = %q, want %q", tt.name, got, tt.wantPath)
		}
	}
}
